# FluentQt

> FluentQt is a C++17 Qt Widgets component library with optional PySide6 bindings. This index routes coding agents to public APIs, machine-readable UI guidance, executable samples, and validation contracts.

## AI-assisted GUI development

- [AI-friendly entry point](docs/ai/README.md): scope, compatibility, commands, and roadmap
- [Add a GUI to any project](docs/ai/add-gui-to-project.md): evidence-driven workflow for existing and greenfield projects
- [Generated AI catalog](docs/ai/generated/fluentqt-ai-catalog.json): versioned integration patterns, public C++/Python APIs, components, tests, and samples
- [AI catalog schema](docs/ai/fluentqt-ai-catalog.schema.json): JSON Schema draft 2020-12 contract
- [Project analysis schema](docs/ai/project-analysis.schema.json): optional machine-readable target-project analysis
- [AI regression scenarios](docs/ai/evals/scenarios.json): project-shape coverage and deterministic intent-retrieval cases
- [AI regression schema](docs/ai/evals/scenarios.schema.json): machine-readable fixture contract
- [FluentQt GUI Skill](.agents/skills/build-fluentqt-gui/SKILL.md): self-contained Agent Skill shared by Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and other compatible agents

## Public integration

- [Project overview](README.md): supported Qt versions, CMake setup, Python bindings, and packaging
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): issue quality, local validation, public API, and pull-request scope
- [C++ hello world](examples/hello_world): minimal in-tree and installed-package consumer
- [PySide6 bindings](bindings/pyside6/README.md): build, package, and compatibility workflow
- [Architecture contracts](docs/architecture/README.md): reusable component and overlay boundaries

## Development and verification

- [Development workflow](docs/development/README.md): canonical contributor workflow index
- [Testing workflow](docs/development/testing-workflow.md): focused targets, CTest labels, and visual tests
- [Component API conventions](docs/development/component-api-conventions.md): public API and implementation rules
- [DataGrid API contract](docs/development/datagrid-api-proposal.md): model/view ownership, staged delivery, and acceptance matrix
- [Accessibility contract](docs/development/accessibility-contract.md): semantic, keyboard, event, and audit requirements
- [Gallery sample optimization](docs/development/app-sample-optimization.md): preview/snippet semantic alignment

## Query without loading the full catalog

```bash
python3 tools/ai/query_ai_catalog.py --search "expandable hierarchy"
python3 tools/ai/query_ai_catalog.py --component tree-view
python3 tools/ai/query_ai_catalog.py --pattern greenfield
python3 tools/ai/evaluate_ai_catalog.py --project-root .
```
